senses.sense_definition: A fixed price paid or charged for something, especially goods or services.

examples.text: The hotel offers a special discounted <w>rate</w> for guests staying over the weekend.

examples.text: You will be paid an hourly <w>rate</w> for your work on this project.

target_lang_translations.ru: Вам будут платить по почасовой <w>ставке</w> за работу над этим проектом.
target_lang_translations.tr: Bu projedeki çalışmanız için size saatlik bir <w>ücret</w> ödenecektir.
target_lang_translations.zh: 你在这项工作中的报酬将按小时<w>费率</w>计算。
